subject: EmbedWorks + Redwood: Hands-on lab series, DevCast podcast & co-hosted webinar
messages:
From: Leah Kim <leah@embedworks.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-21T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: EmbedWorks + Redwood: co-marketing idea (hands-on lab + podcast + webinar)

Hi Diego + Marissa —

Quick intro: I run partnerships at EmbedWorks (we build developer tooling for embedding LLMs). Wed love to run a short joint program with Redwood that mixes 3 things: a paid "hands-on lab" (interactive workshop with live environment), a cross-published episode on DevCast (developer-focused podcast), and a co-hosted product webinar. Goal is to drive developer sign-ups and a short pipeline for our mutual ISV customers.

Tentative asks from our side:
- 2-hour hands-on lab with 2 Redwood engineers (demo + live Q&A)
- 30-40m podcast slot for senior PM/engineer from Redwood
- 60m webinar with joint demo and joint landing page

Weve attached a short proposal (EmbedWorks-Proposal-v1.pdf) with audience profile, sample runbook and suggested KPIs (registrations, trial starts, MQLs). For timing were thinking April 18-29 (hands-on labs across two evenings), podcast in late April and webinar in early May. Flexible if you have conflicts.

Would love to set a 30m sync next week to align on scope, audience, and mutual responsibilities (assets, promos, post-event nurture).

Best,
Leah Kim
Partnerships Lead, EmbedWorks
leah@embedworks.com

Attachment: EmbedWorks-Proposal-v1.pdf (1 page - campaign sketch)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Leah Kim <leah@embedworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-21T12:01:00-08:00
Subject: Re: EmbedWorks + Redwood: co-marketing idea (hands-on lab + podcast + webinar)

Leah — thanks for the crisp proposal and the PDF. This is right up our alley.

Quick replies / clarifying Qs:
- Audience: are you targeting developer practitioners at Series A+ startups, or broader dev-ops/platform engineers at mid-market/enterprise? That will change our speaker and SE staffing.
- Hands-on lab: we can support two evenings but will need one Redwood SE (Sergio) plus a product advocate. Can you confirm maximum seats per session and whether youll provide environments (we can host ephemeral infra if needed).
- Dates: April 19/21 or May 5/7 look workable for us. Which do you prefer?
- Promo: well commit to an email send to our developer list and organic social; marketing will want a 2-week lead time for paid ads.

Im looping in Marissa (Alliances) and Sergio (Solutions) to scope staffing and the marketing ask. Ill also attach our partner-ask template so we can get a mutual action plan in place.

If youre free Thursday at 11am PT I can grab a 30m slot.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-partner-ask-template.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Leah Kim <leah@embedworks.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-22T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: EmbedWorks + Redwood: co-marketing idea (hands-on lab + podcast + webinar)

Thanks Leah — excited about this. A few operational notes from Alliances/Marketing: 

- KPIs well track: registrations, attendance rate, demo requests, trial starts (track via joint HubSpot form). Target CPA for paid social is $45-80 depending on segment.
- Creative: well need co-branded hero banner, speaker headshots, short speaker bios and summary blurbs at least 10 business days before the first promo send.
- Landing page: please confirm if EmbedWorks wants to host or we build a joint landing page; preference is joint landing page on our site with an embedworks parameter for tagging.
- Email cadence: 1 announcement, 2 reminders (7 days, 1 day), and a replay follow-up. We can commit to one paid social push (LinkedIn dev audience) and organic Twitter/X, Mastodon posts.

If you can confirm audience profile (developer platform vs ISV buyers) and preferred run dates well draft the campaign timeline and share a HubSpot campaign link.

Thanks — looping in Sergio for SE capacity and to double-check hands-on environment requirements.

Marissa Cole
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Related resources: https://app.hubspot.com/campaigns/7421/embedworks-redwood-campaign, https://drive.redwood.com/Shared/EmbedWorks-Intro-Deck.pdf
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-24T15:20:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: EmbedWorks + Redwood: co-marketing idea (hands-on lab + podcast + webinar)

Forwarding Leahs note — I approve a modest sponsorship budget to cover paid social and platform credits for demo environments. Next steps from GTM/Leadership side: 

1) Legal to review a short MOU (scope + IP + data handling). Ive attached a baseline MOU-template.docx — please have Legal take a quick look and redline this week.
2) Create a 6-week timeline: week 0 sign MOU, weeks 1-3 asset build + landing page, week 4-5 promo, week 6 events + follow-up.
3) Assign owners: Diego (partner PM), Marissa (campaign owner), Sergio (technical lead), Marketing (ads + email).
4) Small budget approved: up to $8k for paid social + $2k in infra credits for hands-on labs (redeemable against Redwood dev pool).

Diego/Marissa — please confirm youve got the MOU and SOW templates attached and schedule a kickoff with Leah for Thursday if available.

Hannah Schmitt
VP, Alliances & Partnerships, Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.com
